heroHeadline: Day 969: Ultra-Orthodox Protesters Clash with Police Over IDF Conscription as Knesset Coalition Tensions Escalate; Hamas Qassam Command Vacuum Day 6; 29 Days to July 1 Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. June 1, 2026 (Day 968 / Ceasefire Day 235): Hamas's Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades have had no publicly named supreme commander for five consecutive days following the May 27 IDF strike that killed Mohammed Odeh (himself only 9 days into the role after succeeding al-Haddad, killed May 16). The rapid back-to-back elimination of two Qassam commanders within 11 days represents an unprecedented military succession crisis; Hamas is exercising extreme operational security around any successor's identity to avoid immediate NILI targeting. Imad Aqel — Hamas's covert logistics/tunnel commander — remains the last surviving senior October 7 architect and the NILI task force's primary remaining target. On the international legal front, the ICJ granted South Africa an extension until November 22, 2027 to file its reply memorial in the South Africa v. Israel genocide case (Case 192), with Israel's rejoinder due May 2029 — the full merits phase will extend for years. ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant remain active. May 31, 2026 (Day 967): Haredi coalition parties threatened to back the independent October 7 probe unless the Knesset advanced the ultra-Orthodox daycare subsidy bill — coalition horse-trading with 1,195 victims' families' demands. The Kallner inquiry bill still needs three more plenum readings, effectively unpassable before elections; the Knesset preliminary dissolution vote passed 110-0 on May 20. Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara called the Kallner bill 'tailor-made for the government's personal needs.' May 30 (Day 966): The IDF formally shut down its Hostages HQ — 846 days after October 7 — after all 251 hostages were fully accounted for (168 alive, 83-85 bodies repatriated). May 29 (Day 965): Imad Aqel identified as sole surviving senior October 7 architect. 3,005+ ceasefire violations; 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire began October 10, 2025. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
